description: KEPCO Power Data Open Portal (전력데이터 개방 포털시스템) is a data portal run by Korea Electric Power Corporation. The portal opens KEPCO data on electricity consumption by region and contract type, distribution facilities, outages, renewable connection and tariffs, as files and an open API. Coverage: South Korea. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, api; access is free of charge; the API needs registration. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("전력데이터 개방 포털시스템") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support electricity demand and distribution studies of Korea. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
